title: Tell /review-code reviewers to read the lens files with the file-read tool, not a shell loop
outcome: Seen in /review-changes rounds 1, 3 and 4 on 2026-09-26: Claude read-only reviewers tried 'for f in .claude/reviewers/*.md; do cat $f; done' or a multi-file cat. TermAl's read-only policy correctly fails closed on these compound commands. In round 4 (delegation 3e3ecc3b) the reviewer did not retry with the Read tool, so it applied the six lenses from their names only, not their written checklists, which lowers review quality. Fix: in the /review-code command or skill, Step 2 should say to read each lens file with the file-read tool (or one file per shell call), never a shell loop or compound command. Related: tm-exh1 (the checker splitting on quoted '|', a different bug).
